responses.value: Selling 4,000 saunas against 50,000 planned likely means the $3,000 price is too high for most households. I'd compare how many quotes turn into sales at different prices.
Drop: 30% of quotes became sales, above plan, so price isn't it. Far fewer homes have room for one.
Quote requests from homes with room for a sauna against those without. If they request at the same rate, I'd drop it.
